snippet.title: Soulstonia - Official Pre-Alpha Gameplay with Developer Commentary
snippet.description:
Get an extended first look at Soulstonia with developer commentary covering the opening of a new game, the procedurally generated world, Summoner autonomy, quests, skills, gathering, crafting, combat, exploration, and more.

Soulstonia is a Cozy Idle RPG Sim where you recruit Summoners with minds of their own, train 20+ skills, summon creatures, and explore a living fantasy world at your own pace.
Take direct control whenever you want, or let your Summoners keep gathering, crafting, fighting, exploring, and growing while idle. 

This video features pre-alpha gameplay. Visuals, UI, animations, balance, content, and other elements shown are still in development and may change before release.

Wishlist Soulstonia on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4432150/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=steam_page_launch
Visit the Website
https://gabrielsgames.com/soulstonia

In this gameplay walkthrough:
* Create and control your first Summoner
* Explore one version of Soulstonia’s procedurally generated world
* Meet characters and begin the opening quests
* Train skills through gathering, crafting, and combat
* See how Summoners continue acting independently while idle
* Discover resources, villages, points of interest, and other world content

Soulstonia Team
Gabriel Langlois - Creator / Game Developer
Shawn Patrick Campbell - Music Composer
Charlie McCabe - Writer / Narrative Designer
Daniel Larsen - Video Editor / Social Media Consultant
Andrew 'Odie' Odella - Publishing Advisor / Quality Assurance
